items: `template/src/pdca_harness/merge.py:582-601` — The message says the PR "is blocked by" the threads or the CHANGES_REQUESTED review whenever `mergeStateStatus` is `BLOCKED` and any exist. GitHub only blocks on unresolved threads when "require conversation resolution" is on, and only blocks on a CHANGES_REQUESTED review when reviews are required. So a PR blocked by a missing approval or a ruleset, which also happens to have an open thread, is reported as a remarks block, and the real cause is dropped (for example, `reviewDecision == "REVIEW_REQUIRED"` never shows up in the message). The brief accepts this guess, but the wording claims a cause the driver cannot confirm. Decide whether that is acceptable, or soften the wording to something like "BLOCKED; unresolved remarks: …" and include `reviewDecision`.
